title: Santana Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Gherkin Variety
description:
Grow Your Own Crisp, Flavourful Gherkins for Pickling & Fresh Eating!


KEY FEATURES
• High-yielding F1 hybrid gherkin variety
• Produces uniform, dark green, small cucumbers (7-10 cm) ideal for pickling
• Crisp, tender, and flavourful fruits with excellent storage quality
• Vigorous, disease-resistant plants suitable for open field or greenhouse cultivation
• Provides a continuous harvest from mid-summer to mid-autumn


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus
Colour: Dark green (fruit)
Season: Mid-summer to mid-autumn (fruiting)
Growth Habit: Climbing/Scrambling
Flavour: Crisp, tender, and flavourful
Time to Harvest: 50-60 days after sowing (from plug plants, harvest will be sooner)


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Fertile, well-drained soil enriched with compost
Watering: Consistent watering, especially during fruiting; keep soil evenly moist but avoid wetting leaves. Water at the base.
Spacing: 30-40 cm between plants, 100 cm between rows
Height: 1.8m or more (when trained)
Spread: Compact, can be trained vertically
Hardiness: H1C (UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Provide support for climbing plants (e.g., strings or canes) to encourage vertical growth and save space.
• Water regularly at the base of the plant, especially during hot spells and fruit formation, to ensure crisp fruits and prevent fungal diseases.
• Feed weekly with a high-potash fertiliser once flowering begins to encourage continuous fruiting.
• Harvest cucumbers regularly when they are 7-10 cm long for best pickling quality and to encourage further fruit production.
• Protect from slugs, snails, and sudden temperature drops, especially when young. For outdoor growing, plant out after the last frost (late April/May).


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
